name: Author can submit a new SOP for approval

planSteps.description: Sign in as alex.rivera@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
Click the 'Create new SOP' button on the overview page
Fill the SOP title field (input#sop-title) with 'TestSprite submit - vendor payment flow'

Fill the Body content textarea (textarea#sop-body) with 'Purpose
Pay approved vendor invoices on time.

Steps
1. Match the invoice to the purchase order.
2. Get the finance lead's sign-off.
3. Schedule the payment.'
Click the 'Submit for approval' button in the 'Ready to submit?' sidebar card
The SOP detail page opens showing the title 'TestSprite submit - vendor payment flow' with a 'Pending review' version badge
